verdict.rationale: Steel ships first-party agent-facing pieces: a steel-browser skill plus the CLI so a coding agent can control a browser, a way to expose a Steel browser to any MCP client, and in-process MCP tools for the Claude Agent SDK. Natural-language operation is therefore possible, but only through an external LLM agent; Steel has no native natural-language command interface of its own. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language interface in Steel itself, documentation of end-user natural-language command flows, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
